description: Ten fixed questions for the Phase-1 vertical slice. Score with evidence, not vibes.

items.question: What does RTMA stand for?
items.reference_answer: Run · Trace · Metric · Artifact — the evidence habit for AI labs.

items.question: Which UC troubleshooting grammar does RTMA mirror?
What is a token in LLM systems (simple definition)?
items.reference_answer: A token is a chunk of text the model reads or writes — not always a full word.

items.question: What is a hallucination in this lab’s language?
items.reference_answer: A fluent answer that is not grounded in evidence.

items.question: Why use a tool call instead of letting the model invent a calculation?
items.reference_answer: Tool calls use a schema and return exact results instead of invented numbers.

items.question: What is the default local host:port pattern for Ollama?
Name one non-goal of the first AI free pack.
items.reference_answer: Not a 760MB single HTML (browser-hostile mega files).

items.question: What must never go into the public git repo?
items.reference_answer: API keys / secrets (also customer data and private chats).

items.question: What is the suggested future public GitHub repo name for this pack?
What is the Phase-1 golden path in four steps?
items.reference_answer: local hello → tool call → eval of 10 questions → GREEN pack.
